verdict.rationale: The docs pack only glancingly mentions the ability to 'extend checkout' alongside building apps/integrations (bigcommerce-docs-3), with no detail on specific extension points for fields, branding, discount logic, or validation rules. Missing for 10: dedicated Checkout SDK/Checkout Customization API docs, examples of custom fields/branding hooks, discount and validation logic extension points, and independent developer corroboration of using these extension points instead of forking checkout.
